intro.title: Migrate to another wallet
intro.explanation: This moves control of your identity to a different wallet (e.g. from a hot wallet to a hardware wallet, or the other way around). It deploys a new smart account for the new wallet, transfers your identity to it, and moves your current balance over — all in a single transaction signed by your current wallet.
intro.guardiansAndDevicesSurvive: Your guardians and device history stay valid automatically, nothing to reconfigure. After migrating, reconnect with the new wallet and go to "Devices" to reauthorize them there.

connectNew.instruction: Connect the NEW wallet now, just to record its address — no transaction will be sent yet.

connectOld.instruction: Now reconnect your CURRENT (old) wallet to authorize the migration.

confirmNew.newAccountLabel: New smart account address (will be deployed)
confirmNew.sameWalletError: That's the same wallet already controlling this identity — choose a different one.

done.title: Migration complete! Your identity now points to:
done.nextSteps: Reconnect with the new wallet and go to "Devices" — a banner there will let you reauthorize your existing devices with one confirmation.
done.oldAddressWarning: Don't send anything else to the old smart account address — its balance was already moved, but it's no longer part of your identity.
